description.trigger: Microsoft To Do is a cloud-based app for organizing work and personal tasks with lists, due dates, reminders, and priorities.
description.integration: Microsoft To Do is a cloud-based task management application that helps users organize their work and personal tasks. It allows creating task lists, setting due dates, adding reminders, and prioritizing tasks.
